name: Northridge Fashion Center
summary: Northridge Fashion Center is an established regional mall in Los Angeles featuring 170 stores and restaurants, offering everything from luxury items to favorite national brands. The center includes major department store anchors, diverse dining options, and a theater multiplex, providing a complete shopping and entertainment experience for the San Fernando Valley community.
demographics: Northridge Fashion Center attracts a diverse, middle to upper-middle class demographic from the San Fernando Valley, with a strong representation of families and young professionals aged 25-54. The trade area serves a multicultural population with significant Hispanic and Asian communities, reflecting the broader demographics of the northwest Los Angeles region. Shoppers typically have household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000 annually, seeking a mix of value and quality in their retail choices. The center draws visitors looking for convenient one-stop shopping experiences, combining fashion, dining, and entertainment options for the entire family.
description: Northridge Fashion Center stands as a premier shopping destination in the San Fernando Valley, serving the Los Angeles community with over 170 stores and restaurants since its establishment. This enclosed regional mall offers an exceptional retail experience that caters to every taste and budget, from luxury items to beloved national brands. Anchored by major department stores and featuring a theater multiplex, the center provides a comprehensive entertainment and shopping experience under one roof. The mall's strategic location at 9301 Tampa Avenue makes it easily accessible to residents throughout the northwest Los Angeles area, drawing shoppers from Northridge, Granada Hills, Porter Ranch, and surrounding communities. With its diverse tenant mix of fashion retailers, family-friendly dining options, and entertainment venues, Northridge Fashion Center has established itself as a cornerstone of the local retail landscape, offering visitors a welcoming environment for shopping, dining, and socializing.
